title: picea likiangensis subsp. rubescens
intro: Picea likiangensis subsp. rubescens, commonly known as Lijiang spruce, is a plant species in the pine family, characterized by its small, scale-like leaves and conical shape. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Picea likiangensis subsp. rubescens include expectorant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory actions, which contribute to its use in treating respiratory and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
